notes.title: Game Update v5.1.1
notes.notes: We've just updated the game to the latest version of the HexWar Engine. This includes various bug fixes and performance improvements!

notes.title: Tank Battle: Pacific - update v3.1.5
notes.notes: Change: Reduced the tree height for better map clarity.

notes.title: Tank Battle: Pacific - Update v3.1.3
notes.notes:
Change: The hex highlights in the first tutorial mission.
Fix: An issue on some displays of the 'End Turn' button highlight size.

notes.title: Tank Battle: Pacific version 3.1.0 update
notes.notes:
Change: Some improvements to the main map display.
 Change: The tree density on some maps.
 Fix: An issue with moving and shooting some units as they move from the sea to a beach.
 Fix: Some terrain was not providing cover against shooting, as per the terrain effects chart.
 Fix: Some woodland hexes were incorrectly allowing units to pass through them in a single movement action.

notes.title: Tank Battle: Pacific - version 3.0.4 update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Change: The 'At War!' Campaign is now available to all players without requiring an email registration.
[*] Fix: The campaign names did not always display correctly in the campaign victory display.
[/list]

notes.title: Tank Battle: Pacific - version 3.0.3 update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fix: Some issues attacking with tanks with a primary hull mounted weapon as well as a turret weapon.
[/list]

notes.title: Tank Battle: Pacific - version 3.0.2 update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fix: Issue of an aircraft image sometimes appearing after selecting off board artillery.
[*] Fix: Some button alignment issues.
[*] Fix: Some spelling errors. 
[/list]

notes.title: Tank Battle: Pacific version 3.0.1 update
notes.notes: Fix: Some sound effects not playing following the last update.

notes.title: Tank Battle: Pacific v3.0.0 Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Add: Support for the Metal graphics system on all Apple devices, improving graphics performance.
[*] Add: Weapon animations.
[*] Change: Reduction in the download size.
[*] Change: Improved: computer player A.I.
[*] Fix: Some projectile animations not displaying.
[*] Fix: Some screen layout issues.
[*] Fix: Missing some mount/dismount buttons.
[/list]

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue were some units would not exit landing craft.

Please send any issues to support@hexwar.com

notes.title: Achievements
notes.notes:
We have added achievements to the game.

Let us  know if there are any issues at support@hexwar.com

notes.title: Patch In!
notes.notes:
We’ve just given Tank Battle Pacific a small update to fix problem scenarios and some all round improvements.

[list][*]Fixed an issue in the Commonwealth campaign, Palambang scenario, where the cargo trucks were still immobile after turn 6.
[*]Add missing terrain information to the Terrain Chart.
[*]Add expanded descriptions for some How-to pages.
[*]General UI improvements.[/list]

We hope everyone is enjoying the game, but please let us know at support@hexwar.com if anyone is having any issues.

~The HexWar Games Team.
